jobs.title: Manager, Corporate Strategy
jobs.description:
Additional Location(s):   N/A
Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance
At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

About the Role:
The Manager, Corporate Strategy is a key member of Boston Scientific’s Corporate Strategy team, independently leading complex strategic workstreams that help shape the company’s long-term direction. This role supports and independently executes strategic workstreams, develops well‑structured insights and recommendations, and collaborates closely with senior members of the team.

The Corporate Strategy team supports Boston Scientific’s CEO, CFO, and Board of Directors on the company’s most consequential strategic questions, including portfolio strategy, growth opportunities, and capital allocation decisions.
Your responsibilities will include:
Strategic Analysis & Insights
- Lead complex, cross-functional strategic analyses on high-priority topics, including market sizing, competitive landscapes, white-space opportunities, emerging technologies, and structural changes affecting Boston Scientific’s markets
- Frame ambiguous business questions, develop hypotheses, establish analytical approaches, and oversee workstreams from problem definition through executive recommendation
- Synthesize primary and secondary research into clear, compelling narratives for senior leadership audiences
- Proactively identify opportunities and risks across Boston Scientific’s global businesses and recommend specific strategic actions

Strategic Planning
- Lead defined components of Boston Scientific’s annual Strategic Planning and Annual Operating Plan processes
- Partner with Business Unit and functional leaders to develop strategy materials and executive‑level presentations
- Manage the development of executive-level presentations and support Executive Committee and Board of Directors readouts
- Help manage the cadence, coordination, and quality of deliverables across assigned planning workstreams

Mergers & Acquisitions / Business Development
- Support the assessment, prioritization, and strategic framing of M&A, venture, and partnership opportunities across Boston Scientific’s global portfolio
- Lead strategic due-diligence workstreams, including market sizing, penetration forecasting, competitive positioning, and evaluation of strategic fit
- Partner with Business Development and business leaders to develop investment theses, pressure-test assumptions, and communicate recommendations

Portfolio & Performance Analysis
- Lead analyses of Boston Scientific’s existing business portfolio and R&D pipeline to inform resource allocation, portfolio priorities, and capital-allocation decisions
- Track organizational and portfolio performance and develop actionable insights for senior leadership
- Integrate internal performance data with external market and competitive perspectives to support enterprise-level decisions

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of relevant experience, or 3+ years with an MBA or other relevant advanced degree, in corporate strategy, management consulting, investment banking, business development, or a related field
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-priority workstreams in a fast-paced environment
- Strong judgment and ability to work effectively through ambiguity
- Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and build alignment around fact-based recommendations
- Experience developing and presenting materials for executive audiences
- High integrity and ability to handle confidential information

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in medical technology, healthcare, or life sciences
- Familiarity with M&A processes and due diligence
- Experience supporting C suite or Board level presentations

About the role:
The Strategic Marketing Program Manager will develop and support strategic marketing initiatives that drive market development, physician engagement, patient conversion, and growth for the Interventional Spine (IVS) business. This role will generate deep patient, physician, and market insights and translate them into actionable strategies that inform marketing investments, commercialization, and future portfolio decisions.

This individual will serve as a strategic insights partner across the IVS business, connecting customer and market insights with business needs and ensuring insights are translated into meaningful action across functions. The role will work across upstream and downstream marketing activities, partnering closely with Sales, Clinical, Medical Affairs, R&D, Digital, and global marketing partners to support evidence-based decision-making and identify opportunities for growth.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Lead patient and physician market research strategy, including ATU, PET, voice-of-customer research, segmentation, persona development, and other qualitative and quantitative research; manage external research partners and ensure high-quality execution.
- Develop and manage an integrated IVS market insights and learning agenda by identifying critical business questions and knowledge gaps, prioritizing research initiatives, and aligning insights investments with key business priorities.
- Synthesize patient, physician, competitive, clinical, market, and technology insights across multiple sources to identify emerging trends, unmet needs, growth opportunities, and strategic implications; translate findings into actionable recommendations for positioning, market development, commercialization, and future portfolio decisions.
- Develop clinical marketing strategies and partner with Clinical and Medical Affairs to translate scientific evidence, clinical data, and customer insights into compelling positioning, messaging, education, and marketing strategies.
- Support upstream marketing, product development, and portfolio strategy through opportunity assessments, voice-of-customer research, market and competitive analysis, product positioning, and identification of unmet customer needs; contribute customer and market insights to cross-functional product development teams as appropriate.
- Support downstream commercialization of the existing and future IVS portfolio by applying market and customer insights to positioning, messaging, launch planning, market development, patient conversion, and integrated marketing strategies.
- Design and execute physician and KOL insight-generation activities, including advisory boards and other qualitative research, and translate findings into actionable marketing, clinical, commercial, and portfolio recommendations.
- Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Clinical, Medical Affairs, R&D, Digital, upstream and downstream Marketing, and global partners to align strategic priorities, communicate insights, influence decision-making, and ensure insights are effectively applied across the business. Manage external agencies, market research vendors, and strategic partners as appropriate to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.

Required qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, Healthcare, or a related field.
- Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience in marketing, market research, strategy, technology commercialization, scientific or clinical research, product development, healthcare, medical devices, life sciences, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
- Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex customer, market, scientific, or business information and translate insights into actionable strategies and recommendations.
- Strong strategic thinking, analytical, communication, presentation, and project management skills.
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively and influence across functions within a matrixed organization.

Preferred qualifications:
- Advanced degree such as an MBA, MS, PhD, or equivalent in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, Engineering, Healthcare, or a related discipline.
- Experience in medical devices, healthcare, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, or another regulated industry.
- Experience in strategic marketing, market research, technology commercialization, market development, or product strategy.
- Experience with physician and patient research, segmentation, persona development, voice-of-customer research, or customer journey mapping.
- Experience supporting upstream or downstream marketing activities, including opportunity assessment, product positioning, commercialization, or product launches.
- Experience translating scientific or clinical evidence into commercially relevant insights and strategies.
- Experience with digital marketing, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, or emerging marketing technologies.
- Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.

Work Mode:
At Boston Scientific, we value collaboration and synergy. This role follows a hybrid work model requiring employees to be in our local office at least three days per week.

Relocation Assistance:
Relocation assistance is not available for this position at this time.

Visa Sponsorship:
Boston Scientific will not offer sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position at this time.

With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

About the role:
Leads HR M&A integration portfolio management and serves as a key strategic partner on the front end of transactions. Partners closely with Business Development, Legal, and BU HR to support pre-diligence deal assessment, shape the HR approach, and ensure effective transition from deal strategy through integration execution. Oversees portfolio priorities, risk, and resources to support successful acquisition outcomes.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Lead HR due diligence and translate findings into deal strategy, risks, and integration priorities.
- Lead front-end HR integration strategy and planning for acquisitions.
- Oversee deal governance across the HR M&A portfolio, including risks, decisions, priorities, and resource needs.
- Manage and develop Program Managers and Project Managers.
- Partner closely with HR M&A Operations for execution across Compensation, Benefits, Data, People Integration, Payroll, and related workstreams.
- Partner with HRBPs, Legal, Business Development, and HR COEs throughout the deal lifecycle.
- Ensure each deal has the right team, resources, and support based on complexity and timing.
- Drive clarity on ownership, decision-making, escalation, and key milestones.
- Build team capability in diligence, integration strategy, and end-to-end deal leadership.
- Provide senior HR leadership during critical deal and integration milestones.
- Serve as a senior leadership backup to the Director, HR M&A COE

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field
- 10+ years of HR experience with significant hands-on involvement in M&A due diligence and integration
- Proven people leadership experience required, with a track record of directly managing and developing teams
- Strong understanding of workforce financials, compliance exposure and HR operating models
- Comfortable leading senior-level discussions and making calls under ambiguity and time pressure
- Willingness to travel and provide onsite support during critical integration milestones

Preferred Qualifications
- MBA or graduate degree
- Advanced MS Office capability; able to produce executive level materials quickly
- Strong partnership experience; ability to collaborate with Business Unit and CoE's
